label: Snow Brand Camembert

branded.why: The first camembert made in Japan, since 1962, and for long the Japanese idea of one.

aka: 雪印 カマンベール

about.text: A bloomy, camembert-style cheese from Hokkaido, made by Megmilk Snow Brand from Hokkaido milk since its sales launch in 1962. The company describes its making as traditional.

sources.text: The product, its milk and the 1962 launch.
